lines.text: Many learners say: I very like coffee.
Say really before like, not very.

data.why: Say really before like, not very.

native.tip: Người Việt hay dịch “rất thích” thành “I very like.” Trong tiếng Anh, hãy nói “I really like.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I very like coffee.” không? ☕ Hãy nói: “I really like coffee.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “really.” Hãy nói to một câu về món bạn thích, bắt đầu bằng “I really like…” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.hook: How do you say you like it?
en.tip: Vietnamese learners often turn “rất thích” into “I very like.” In English, say “I really like.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “I very like coffee.” Say it this way: “I really like coffee.” Listen to Ama read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
